Game Overview

Munnazzaro is a adventure title where embark on a spine-chilling adventure in the pixelated horror world of Munnazzaro. As an outsider in a haunted town, unravel its dark secrets through exploration and clever puzzle-solving. Every corner hides a new mystery in this atmospheric game blending suspense and dark fantasy with nostalgic visuals.
